text:
Maria: quick sync added a new prototype for the credentials table with inline actions and keyboard shortcuts (c = create, r = rotate, v = view secret). figma: https://figma.com/file/cred-proto

Jordan: neat. concern: keyboard shortcuts need clear discoverability. propose a small help pill in the header "Shortcuts: c,r,v" that expands to a modal.

Noah: inline actions are great. but we should keep the primary actions in the row and move destructive actions to a menu to avoid accidental clicks on touchpad.

Sam: rotate modal copy: "Rotate tokenReplaces the active token immediately. Keep services updated." maybe too terse. add the single-show secret reminder.

A11y-bot: accessibility checklist: color contrast, focus indicators, aria-live for secret reveal, keyboard trap for modals, and ensure tooltips are accessible (hover + focus).

Maria: empty state variant B shows three example presets (CI, Analytics, Admin) with one-line descriptions and a create button on each card. helps users pick quickly.

Jordan: good. also the create flow should show a summary page before finalizing (summary includes scopes, expiry, and whether overlap is allowed). helps reduce mistakes.

Noah: dev question: how do we handle rotating tokens used by infra automation? maybe expose a client-side SDK helper to reload env vars. also doc the download .env option.

Sam: copy for "Show secret" toggle: when secret is masked, button text is "Show token"; when revealed, text becomes "Hide token" and the button gets aria-pressed=true. announce via live region.

A11y-bot: flagged that the example CLI in empty state should have language tag for code block to aid screen readers. also ensure copy button announces success.

Maria: final: I'll fold in the pill discovery, move revoke into menu for destructive, add summary page, and put keyboard shortcut modal. will share updated prototype in an hour.

Jordan: add analytics events: token_created_preset, token_revealed, token_rotated, token_revoked_with_undo. helps product understand behavior.

Noah: thumbs up. infra will add SDK helper for env reload.

Sam: looks good from copy side. prefer "Rotate token" for consistency.

A11y-bot: sign-off pending keyboard behavior tests.

Maria: thanks team.
